hypothesis: We can still ship a useful player-focused routine that returns player profile data only, even though season stats are not yet proven usable.
rationale: Experiments show /api/v1/players/{playerId} returns valid JSON (array) while the stats endpoint often returns an error wrapper and we lack concrete working ids. A profile-only routine would still be valuable and aligns with confirmed behavior.
prompt: Design a minimal routine JSON for a `pl_player_profile` routine that: (1) navigates to https://sdp-prem-prod.premier-league-prod.pulselive.com/api/v1/players/{{playerId}}, (2) uses js_evaluate to read document.body.innerText, JSON.parse it, and store the parsed value under a session_storage_key, and (3) returns that key via a return operation. Use integer parameter playerId with example 1. Do NOT execute it; just return the JSON structure you would use.
